title: The Complete Guide to Crystal Astrology: 360 Crystals and Sabian Symbols for Personal Health, Astrology and Numerology

source.author: Marina Costelloe
additionalCredits: Sabian Symbol Key Words reprinted, with permission, from The Sabian Symbols in Astrology by Dr. Marc Edmund Jones (Aurora Press, ISBN 978-0-943358-40-6).
Healing Body Point reprinted, with permission, from A Handbook of Medical Astrology by Jane Ridder-Patrick (CrabApple Press, ISBN 978-0-9551989-0-8).

entries.sabianSymbol: A woman rises out of the water, a seal embraces her.
entries.expression: Obsidian is a shiny, black-green-grey volcanic glass. Obsidian is a protective, shielding stone; it opens opportunities and invites Mermaid Energy into your life.
entries.message: Knowledge is channelled from the unconscious to reality.
entries.sunFocus: Unique and independent, you display a high degree of psychic and creative talent.
entries.affirmation: I provide comfort through awareness.

entries.expression: Orange Aventurine is quartzite with hematite . Orange Aventurine amplifies jovial and merry emotions, firing up optimism. It echoes the Fool tarot card.
entries.message: Charismatic entertainer, satirical and ironic, energising.
entries.sunFocus: Self-confidence and enthusiasm are energised through comedy, lifting the emotions of those around you.
entries.affirmation: I laugh often with others.

entries.sabianSymbol: A cameo profile in the outline of his country
entries.expression: Black Onyx is a variety of quartz often used to create cameos. Onyx helps with the challenges in life, eliminating excess and releasing unnecessary energies.
entries.message: Face-to-face contact enhances clarity, empathy, comprehension and understanding.
entries.sunFocus: Whether politics, government or committee, heading different organizations becomes a prominent aspect of your life; lead the way.
entries.affirmation: I cooperate with people face-to-face.

entries.sabianSymbol: Two lovers strolling along a secluded walk
entries.expression: Chrysoprase is a vibrant green variety of quartz. Chrysoprase brings good fortune, prosperity, and happiness-enhancing friendships. Echoes the Lover’s tarot card energy.
entries.message: Learning to trust others and ourselves, we grow secure in relationships.
entries.sunFocus: You show others the opening of your heart, energising and expressing love with equality and balance.
entries.affirmation: I appreciate balance through love.

entries.expression: A double-terminated quartz is known as a Herkimer Diamond. Herkimer Diamond promotes strong and clear meditation, astral travelling, and aids in past-life memory recall.
entries.message: Generates a heightened perspective, fulfilling understanding.
entries.sunFocus: You focus clear energies from the divine into life, allowing expansion through change.
entries.affirmation: I achieve spiritual enthusiasm through sensitive experiences.

entries.sabianSymbol: A square, brightly lit on one side.
entries.expression: Galena is a cubic lead mineral. Galena provides confidence to see through personal darkness, and the realisation that there is more than empty space – there is divine order.
entries.message: Promoting harmony and balance with a grounding, structured undertone.
entries.sunFocus: You act as a focus for healing and spiritual form in the world; people turn to you in their time of need.
entries.affirmation: I seek self-direction toward spiritual awareness.

entries.sabianSymbol: A man successfully expressing himself in two realms at once
entries.expression: A natural crystal containing amethyst and citrine. Ametrine promotes meditation, boosting psychic abilities and relieving tension; enhances natural talents.
entries.message: Transmutation of successful ideas and actions through space and time.
entries.sunFocus: You positively influence change through light and love in the physical and spiritual realms.
entries.affirmation: I have an aptitude for understanding and enhanced insight.

entries.sabianSymbol: A woman’s hat with streamers blown by the east wind.
entries.expression: Banded Agate is striped agate; colours can range through the spectrum. Banded Agate promotes communication with astral realms, and supports ingenuity and clear thinking.
entries.message: Unique, exciting, uplifting experiences.
entries.sunFocus: You promote uniqueness by respecting positive thought energy that flows toward a purposeful goal.
entries.affirmation: I am free thinking, with expansive intuition.

entries.expression: Clear Quartz is a common mineral. Quartz is very potent, and holds many properties including the concentrating of insight, intuition, healing and divination.
entries.message: Crystal balls see into the past, define the present, and predict the future.
entries.sunFocus: Clearly a spiritually gifted person, you focus potentials into reality.
entries.affirmation: I work responsibly and have profound visions.

entries.sabianSymbol: A man teaching new forms for old symbols
entries.expression: Fossils are the impressions of ancient animals, plants and algae. Fossils aid in the interpretation of developing physical and spiritual life on earth, motivating excellence.
entries.message: Natural designs tempting us to interpret shape and meaning.
entries.sunFocus: You understand and explain the significance of karmic and mundane life patterns.
entries.affirmation: I utilise my skills of interpretation, investigation and communication.

entries.expression: Green Aventurine is quartz that contains fuchsite mica. Green Aventurine stimulates mental alertness and clarity, with the evolution of ideas bringing career success.
entries.message: Achieve greatness with the support of many great people.
entries.sunFocus: Through strength and good fortune you achieve greatness, even under challenging circumstances.
entries.affirmation: I value and respect others and acknowledge mutual support.

entries.expression: A white mineral, Barite naturally occurs with anglesite and celestite. Utilised by Native Americans in shape-shifting rituals, Barite has Angelic energy.
entries.message: Negate harsh re-actions; enhance hope and direction.
entries.sunFocus: You energise life through your spontaneous good nature; use your wings to gain a fresh perspective.
entries.affirmation: I remain light-hearted in all situations due to my higher awareness.

entries.expression: Sodalite is a sodium-bearing mineral. Sodalite fluoresces, energising into the ultraviolet spectrum. Sodalite absolves old patterns, guilt and fear, motivating peaceful change.
entries.message: Clearing, expanding energy used to auspiciously change your fortune.
entries.sunFocus: You offer others and yourself a healing way to release and change outdated patterns.
entries.affirmation: I choose to illuminate and modify my current circumstances.

entries.sabianSymbol: A serpent coiling near a man and a woman
entries.expression: Serpentinite is a green metamorphic rock. Serpentinite promotes intimate love, attracts money, and develops psychic ability. Snake Totem energy, Kundalini energy.
entries.message: Shed outdated facades; reveal the bare essentials; promote self-renewal.
entries.sunFocus: You re-crystallise yourself through passionate interactions with others.
entries.affirmation: I can transform into an ultimate state of being.

entries.sabianSymbol: A wise old Indian woman weaves a blanket
entries.expression: Agatised dinosaur bones are fossilised by silica. Ancient dinosaur fossils tie us energetically to the past and aid in past-life memory work, acting as a calming agent.
entries.message: Concentration, application, visual rewards, spiritual communion.
entries.sunFocus: You bring into existence practical gifts; you work with other people fulfilling a divine purpose.
entries.affirmation: I create an outlet for my highest potential.

entries.sabianSymbol: Brownies dancing in the setting sunlight
entries.expression: Boulder Opal is a colourful opal with a natural backing of ironstone. Boulder Opal promotes a free spirit, amplifies spontaneity and mirrors feelings. Fairy energy abounds.
entries.message: Festive colour, spirit and energy.
entries.sunFocus: You inspire others to fly and dance toward freedom and happiness when you embrace your own vitality.
entries.affirmation: I trip the light fantastic.

entries.expression: Halite or sodium chloride is rock sea salt, and is colourless-to-white, pale blue, or pink. Energetically, Halite, pink in particular, teaches us about love; an alchemical element.
entries.message: Evaporate blocked feelings; expose truths; purify intentions.
entries.sunFocus: You are valued for the practical support you offer people and groups.
entries.affirmation: I am the salt of the earth and a light in the world.

entries.expression: Cape Amethyst is a pale purple variety of amethyst originating from Africa. Cape Amethyst is a natural facilitator of rest and contemplation, promoting peacefulness.
entries.message: Creating space and time invites freedom of thought.
entries.sunFocus: Contemplation, consideration and meditation advance personal enlightenment.
entries.affirmation: I use meditation to guide spirit to the centre of my being.

entries.expression: Tektites are glassy, terrestrial rocks formed by impacts from extraterrestrial objects. Tektites are used as talismans, assisting energy fields, communications, and flying.
entries.message: Transports spirit and emotion to new heights with ease.
entries.sunFocus: Rapid transitions between various physical and spiritual states impact your world in magical ways.
entries.affirmation: I see surrounding influences that others cannot envisage.

entries.sabianSymbol: A young girl feeding birds in winter
entries.expression: Rhodochrosite is a pinkish red, manganese carbonate mineral. Rhodochrosite supports the understanding that we are always loved; it promotes a welcoming energy.
entries.message: Angelic energy generously satisfies physical and spiritual hunger.
entries.sunFocus: Your serene nature beautifully comforts your friends and family; you are rewarded with happiness.
entries.affirmation: I am kind and generous. I provide a safe haven for those in need.

entries.expression: Hematite is a blackish, silver-grey, iron mineral. Hematite strengthens the mind, is grounding, and helps balance and fortify the body-mind-spirit connection.
entries.message: Steely determination, iron resolve, defend what it is you believe.
entries.sunFocus: You face life with great confidence; you empower others with your drive and focus.
entries.affirmation: I exercise mind, body and spirit – a soul’s crusade.

entries.sabianSymbol: The gate to the garden of desire
entries.expression: Crystallised carbon, the diamond is the hardest natural crystal. Diamonds amplify pure love and promote purity, beauty, wealth, evolution, and invincibility.
entries.message: Amplified intentions, refracting inner dreams outward to ideas and action.
entries.sunFocus: Searching for the beauty in all things promotes brilliant success.
entries.affirmation: I reflect eternal possibilities in all I do.

entries.sabianSymbol: A woman in pastel colours carrying a heavy and valuable but veiled load.
entries.expression: Hiddenite, the green variety of spodumene, is a valuable gemstone. Hiddenite attracts prosperity, supports emotions, and builds trust. Echoes the High Priestess tarot card.
entries.message: Access the archaic records and secret universal knowledge.
entries.sunFocus: You have the ability to anticipate, and prepare people for life’s challenges.
entries.affirmation: I wait in humble anticipation for future endeavours to come to fruition.

entries.sabianSymbol: An open window and a net curtain blowing into a cornucopia
entries.expression: Alexandrite is a gemstone variety of chrysoberyl. Alexandrite promotes good luck, spiritual and material prosperity, and abundance.
entries.message: Bountiful information providing ideas, warnings, details, and inspiration.
entries.sunFocus: Others wonder at your open, generous spirit; you are a beautiful soul.
entries.affirmation: I am open to opportunities and I provide opportunities for others.

entries.expression: Banded Iron Stone is an ancient, sedimentary, iron oxide and chert rock. Banded Iron Stone promotes transformation, and answers questions from the beginning of time.
entries.message: Foresight promotes spiritual understanding; cooperation advances social harmony.
entries.sunFocus: Internal strength and hope pave the way for a confident life; let people see the real you, for you are a visionary.
entries.affirmation: My empathy resolves fear.

entries.sabianSymbol: A man possessed of more gifts than he can hold
entries.expression: Elbaite is a colourful gemstone variety of tourmaline. Tourmaline supports spiritual development, protection, grounding, and enhances native talents.
entries.message: Natural endowment. Harness and develop talents.
entries.sunFocus: Contributing to life in many ways, you are an instrument that facilitates social advancement.
entries.affirmation: I realise abundance in my life.

entries.expression: Red Garnet is a hard, glassy gemstone. Red Garnet brings positive thoughts to relationships; it is an excellent stone for manifesting favourable possibilities.
entries.message: Successful encounters and new ideas through thought and vision.
entries.sunFocus: Assessment and critical analysis expand your vision, and in turn manifest opportunities.
entries.affirmation: I am responsible for my self-motivation and the evolution of my ideas.

entries.expression: Sard is a reddish-brown variety of chalcedony. Traditionally Sard protects from disappointment by softening expectations and stimulating situational awareness.
entries.message: Expectations are high, but alternatives exist; reconnect to the divine for support.
entries.sunFocus: Your gift is to unite people in a common purpose, changing the old for improved patterns.
entries.affirmation: I can realign my internal dialogue and benefit everyone.

entries.expression: Celestite is a strontium-sulphate mineral. Celestite connects to the heavenly realms and promotes higher consciousness pursuits. It strengthens clear and honest communication.
entries.message: Celestial clarity in perceiving angels, listening to divine messages.
entries.sunFocus: You perceive angels, listen for their harmony in your life, and share your experiences with others.
entries.affirmation: I join in Angelic adoration, bearing witness to divine love.

entries.sabianSymbol: A pond, a duck and ducklings.
entries.expression: Rhyolite is an extrusive volcanic rock that appears in a variety of colours and textures. Rhyolite promotes happy people entering your life, particularly children.
entries.message: Safe, secure and happy home environment.
entries.sunFocus: You are dependable and faithful, helping those around you with grace and love.
entries.affirmation: I am worthy of trust; people look to me for guidance.

entries.expression: Clear Spinel is a magnesium, aluminium oxide gemstone. Clear Spinel rejuvenates mind, body and spirit, promoting new avenues for success.
entries.message: Unique, individual messages through simple channels.
entries.sunFocus: Your fresh inspiration and free spirit flow towards others, promoting flexibility and rejuvenation.
entries.affirmation: I live naturally in all ways.

entries.expression: Electrum is a naturally occurring, gold-silver-copper metal. Fulgurite is lightning-fused quartz. Spiritually, both crystal elements aid in transition; echoes the Tower tarot card.
entries.message: Alchemy, power and force transform mundane life to that of purest gold.
entries.sunFocus: Sudden and unexpected life events act as a catalyst for awareness, insight, and purification.
entries.affirmation: My talent for transformation brings immediate revelations.

entries.sabianSymbol: Steps up to a lawn blooming with clover
entries.expression: A white variety of agate, Moss Agate has green manganese and iron oxide dendritic inclusions. Moss Agate traditionally promotes abundance, good health, and prosperity.
entries.message: Hope, inspiration, kindness, a smooth life journey.
entries.sunFocus: Your optimism throughout life successfully promotes personal and collective growth and love.
entries.affirmation: My mature intentions nurture understanding.

entries.expression: A man-made stone made of glass and copper glitter. Alchemically symbolising the transmutation of gold process, Goldstone is uplifting, energising, and increases happiness.
entries.message: Sustain spiritual pursuits; discover treasures of the human realm.
entries.sunFocus: You are a confident person. Trust in the divine; show others how to remain virtuous.
entries.affirmation: I have faith, hope and love.

entries.sabianSymbol: A widow at an open grave
entries.expression: Geodes have a crystalline cavity filled with quartz, amethyst, agate, jasper. Offering protection, cooperation, purification and harmony, Geodes specifically guide the spirit upward.
entries.message: Elevated awareness of self with regard to time and place.
entries.sunFocus: Personal relationships have substance beyond material existence; share your belief systems with others.
entries.affirmation: I sense beyond the physical, and believe.

entries.sabianSymbol: A bridge being built across a gorge
entries.expression: Astrophyllite is a golden-yellow, titanium mineral. Astrophyllite reconnects the inner and outer realms, between self and others, the divine and the mundane.
entries.message: Positive transitions, supportive when moving on to a new evolutionary stage.
entries.sunFocus: Not limited by space and time, your insight, intuition and foresight connect people to places and circumstances.
entries.affirmation: I have a safe pathway through life.

entries.expression: Soapstone is a metamorphic rock. Soapstone has hidden power and strength; it retains and transmits heat, and is physically and spiritually warming. Goddess Energy.
entries.message: Understated kind service, love, and honour; life is revitalised.
entries.sunFocus: Through your kindness, you draw attention to causes that lead to the betterment of society.
entries.affirmation: My comforting deeds soothe the spirit.

entries.expression: Larvikite is a coarse-grained, feldspar-rich rock with blue flash reflections. Spiritually, Larvikite promotes durability, steadiness and strength, turning dreams into reality.
entries.message: To everything there is a season, a time to every purpose under heaven.
entries.sunFocus: You are a vehicle for environmental concerns; your support through practical actions makes you a mover and a shaker.
entries.affirmation: By maintaining my purpose I support others in their divine purpose.

entries.expression: Fuchsite is chromium-rich, green mica. Spiritually, fuchsite channels physical and emotional healing; it invites friendliness, compassion and lightheartedness into the home.
entries.message: Goodwill, loving intentions, respect for all celebrations of spirit.
entries.sunFocus: Your strengths are: promoting hope, uniting people with mutual ideals, sharing joyful experiences.
entries.affirmation: I create harmony using meaningful signs and ceremonial actions.

entries.expression: Iron-stained calcium carbonate is termed Red Calcite. Red Calcite fortifies courage and strength, reduces physical stress, and increases energy to handle survival situations.
entries.message: Call attention to caring and allow yourself to be cared for.
entries.sunFocus: While caring for others, travel, adventure and discipline complete your life.
entries.affirmation: My skill is in immediate action; I save lives.

entries.expression: Rhodonite is a red, manganese-rich pyroxene mineral. Traditionally Rhodonite boosts self esteem, compassion, beauty and kindness, encouraging gentleness and self care.
entries.message: Gentle, kind growth of intentions manifesting into reality.
entries.sunFocus: Honesty and kindness, expressed through genuine forethought, gather true friends and abundant blessings.
entries.affirmation: I am involved in fruitful relationships.

entries.expression: Window Quartz Crystals have a rhombic facet below the apex. Window Quartz Crystals enhance the qualities of any stones positioned close by, and act as energy amplifiers.
entries.message: Looking, seeing, appraising, making realistic assessments.
entries.sunFocus: Others respect your evaluations as you see with openness and clarity; you provide accurate information and responses.
entries.affirmation: I use visual cues to make valuable comparisons and judgements.

entries.expression: Bauxite is an orangey-brown, aluminium-rich, sedimentary rock. Bauxite absorbs negativity and clarifies native talents; an alchemical element fostering reformation of spirit.
entries.message: Take control of the situation and deliver positive outcomes.
entries.sunFocus: Application and diligence afford you supportive environments to move forward and prosper.
entries.affirmation: I am flexible and resilient.

entries.expression: Known as Nacre, Mother of Pearl is a naturally-occurring, iridescent, calcium carbonate. Mother of Pearl intensifies intuition and creativity. It is highly protective for children.
entries.message: Child-like innocence, simplicity, joy and carefree play.
entries.sunFocus: Your charm shines happiness and fun into people’s hearts and their daily activities.
entries.affirmation: I live in harmony with all that is around me.

entries.sabianSymbol: A man wearing a muffler and a stylish silk hat
entries.expression: Wulfenite is a crystalline, molybdenum and lead ore mineral. Wulfenite is a warming crystal, invigorating emotions and motivating action.
entries.message: Carefree elegance in movement and manner, admired by peers.
entries.sunFocus: You have a conspicuously unique style, a trendsetter in all you do.
entries.affirmation: My stylish individuality adds to my visual appeal.

entries.sabianSymbol: An old man attempting vainly to reveal the mysteries
entries.expression: Clay is fine-grained particles including kaolinite. Clay captures and stores emotions and information, and enhances accurate and detailed work.
entries.message: Compassion and respect, striving together to reach enlightenment.
entries.sunFocus: Through your persistence and determination you attract divine blessings; record them for future reference.
entries.affirmation: I will keep preserving with compassion and grace.

entries.sabianSymbol: A symbolic battle between swords and torches
entries.expression: Jacinth is a red variety of zircon. Jacinth is a stone of deep wisdom and helps promises and sacred vows to remain intact, in line with our highest intention.
entries.message: Richness in spirit, a sense of justice, guided by strong convictions.
entries.sunFocus: Single-mindedness and self-determination motivate you to answer important questions.
entries.affirmation: I am balanced, thoughtful, and energetic.

entries.sabianSymbol: A woman holding a bag out of a window
entries.expression: Anthophyllite is a distinctive, brown-coloured amphibole mineral. Anthophyllite serves to purify and cleanse the body, mind and spirit.
entries.message: Movement of ideas, karma and feelings. Light and space are invited in.
entries.sunFocus: Your personal magnetism facilitates cooperation and achievement.
entries.affirmation: I surrender my limitations to accomplish greatness.

entries.sabianSymbol: A newly formed continent rising majestically from the ocean
entries.expression: Olivine is an olive-green mineral, a fundamental component of the earth’s mantle. Olivine is a healing mineral, facilitating awareness and access to the earth’s energy grid.
entries.message: Powerfully promotes new opportunities and growth through raw energy.
entries.sunFocus: Growth through powerful decision-making positively affects those around you.
entries.affirmation: Newfound lands and spirit provide me with every opportunity to succeed.

entries.sabianSymbol: Wisps of cloud streaming across the sky
entries.expression: Spotted Lapis is Lapis Lazuli rich in calcite. Spotted Lapis promotes love and respect, lightens emotions, and allows stress, worries, fear and anger to drift away.
entries.message: Anticipating change in life force, energy, and vigour.
entries.sunFocus: Your virtuous thoughts and prayers really do make a difference in life.
entries.affirmation: I see evidence of fleeting realities that guide me to greater spiritual heights.

entries.sabianSymbol: A finger pointing in an open book
entries.expression: Slate is a fine-grained, metamorphic rock that splits into thin sheets. Spiritually, slate enhances memory work, accurate history, and record keeping.
entries.message: Blank slates to create on, translate and understand, then wipe clean.
entries.sunFocus: Your systematic investigation skills help you establish facts, and compile them for future reference.
entries.affirmation: I confirm my life direction by examining the facts.

entries.expression: Dioptase is a rare, copper mineral. Dioptase brings profound happiness, heals past hurts on all levels, and empowers the heart to be guided into a place of strength and confidence.
entries.message: Desire goodness, with peaceful confidence.
entries.sunFocus: You provide messages of hope and confidence, with graceful serenity.
entries.affirmation: I hold a true course and direct others to safety.

entries.expression: Emerald is gemstone-quality, green beryl. Emeralds have an extensive list of spiritual attributes including protection, spiritual growth, faith, and intelligent communication.
entries.message: Incorporating protection, betterment, sensation and radiance.
entries.sunFocus: Precious soul, you have many treasures – spiritual, emotional, creative, to name a few.
entries.affirmation: I protect the best values in life.

entries.sabianSymbol: An Indian with his speeding horse, and a scalp hanging from his belt.
entries.expression: Jasper is a variety of quartz. Jasper is an excellent grounding stone, generous in providing courage and personal independence.
entries.message: Loyalty, strength, justice, admiration and respect.
entries.sunFocus: Ferocity, skill, balance and coordination aid you in standing up for human rights.
entries.affirmation: I rely on my own determination, focus and energy to move me toward success.

entries.sabianSymbol: A large and well-kept public park
entries.expression: Brazilianite is an unusual, green-yellow, phosphate-based gemstone. This stone promotes friendship, lightens auras, and helps heal minor ailments.
entries.message: Refresh and renew, enjoy and relax.
entries.sunFocus: Your playful, comfortable nature facilitates for many people an escape from the mundane activities in life.
entries.affirmation: I am completely refreshed after communing with nature.

entries.expression: Rubellite, a natural tourmaline, sparkles through the red, pink and purple colour range. Traditionally Rubellite strengthens love, passion, emotional balance, and devotion.
entries.message: Overflowing passion, devotion sustained by harmony.
entries.sunFocus: Extravagance, beauty and love permeate your life; you let everyone see your passion for living.
entries.affirmation: I show love through care, attention, and clear intention.

entries.expression: Turquoise is a valuable stone. Prized equally by many cultures, turquoise is a protective stone, aiding in truthful communication and meditation.
entries.message: Persuasive influences, alternative courses for unconditional love.
entries.sunFocus: Wisdom and secrecy are your strengths; others offer you goodwill.
entries.affirmation: I accept, release, and allow space for the exchange of energy.

entries.sabianSymbol: A woman pursued by mature romance
entries.expression: Morganite is pink, gem-quality beryl. Morganite inspires devotion, compassion, equality, empathy and patience, motivating a more mature loving life.
entries.message: Aroused by the soft, gentle exploration of love, with sensitive boundaries.
entries.sunFocus: You appear completed through your consideration and perfected sensibilities.
entries.affirmation: My intuitive awareness sustains beautiful sentiment.

entries.sabianSymbol: Two cobblers working at a table
entries.expression: Gabbro is a dark-coloured plutonic rock, composed of plagioclase and pyroxene. Gabbro spiritually balances and enhances personal magnetism and cooperation at work.
entries.message: Practical relationships manufacture opportunities to fulfil spiritual obligations.
entries.sunFocus: Your specific skill set forms the basis for support and reward.
entries.affirmation: I utilise my tools, skills and passion to fulfil my vocation.

entries.sabianSymbol: A peacock parading on an ancient lawn
entries.expression: Peacock Ore tarnishes to brilliant iridescent blue, green, and purple. Peacock Ore clears the mind, aids in concentration, and promotes beauty through self-confidence.
entries.message: Success and confidence displayed, avail yourself of every advantage.
entries.sunFocus: Reserved contentment and prestige, derived from radiating self-assuredness.
entries.affirmation: I enjoy grandeur, mystery, spectacle and fanfare.

entries.sabianSymbol: A glass-bottomed boat reveals undersea wonders
entries.expression: Petoskey Stone is an ancient fossilized coral. Spiritually, Petoskey amplifies Neptune’s energy, unlocking the emotional self.
entries.message: An Atlantean shift in energy, glimpses of deep unconscious thought.
entries.sunFocus: Your phenomenal capacity for friendship brings to life: community well-being, admiration, and respect.
entries.affirmation: Natural diversity inspires wonder and awe in me.

entries.expression: Agate is a widely used term applied to banded silica; iron oxide creates Red Agate. Red Agate is a high-energy stone, increasing self-confidence and harmony within groups.
entries.message: Generous spirit, the bringer of goodwill, especially toward children.
entries.sunFocus: You provide hope in difficult times; you remind others how to wish and dream and why these emotions are important.
entries.affirmation: I look forward to surprise gifts and the emotions they awaken in me.

entries.expression: Orthoclase is an important igneous mineral. Orthoclase brings a sense of refinement and appreciation of the finer things in life.
entries.message: Noble and worthy traits are idealised and replicated.
entries.sunFocus: You are a guide, showing others the way to a comfortable and tranquil life.
entries.affirmation: I look forward to a time for indulgence and pleasure in my life.

entries.expression: Watermelon Tourmaline has a pink-red core and green edges. Watermelon Tourmaline promotes love, protection, and family acceptance.
entries.message: Joyful ceremonies bring together family and community.
entries.sunFocus: Your ability to organise celebrations of the spirit promotes a return to simple delights with family and friends.
entries.affirmation: I feel peace and joy as I feel safe.

entries.expression: Crazy Lace Agate is brightly coloured, elaborately banded silica rock. Crazy Lace Agate elevates the mind, promotes eloquence in communication, and buoys self-confidence.
entries.message: Clear and honest communication; sensational and contrasting points of view.
entries.sunFocus: Courage, determination and self-promotion open the way for new endeavours.
entries.affirmation: I investigate modern culture through information exchange.

entries.expression: Augite is a dark green-black, magnesium-rich pyroxene. Spiritually, Augite offers alternative routes for discovering riches, acting as a guide on the path to awareness.
entries.message: Pinpoint options and evaluate risks, while acquiring knowledge and resources.
entries.sunFocus: You have the ability to persevere till you succeed; you show others where riches are to be found and that finding them is worth the effort.
entries.affirmation: I know meaningful exploration unearths unforeseen wealth.

entries.expression: Pure Limestone is a white sedimentary rock. Many spiritual locations are found in and around Limestone locations. A subtle but strong energy, Limestone acts as a conduit for positive forces.
entries.message: A natural reverence for purity and spirit.
entries.sunFocus: You connect deeply with emotion and spirit, accessing this resource to find creative solutions to issues that arise within your life.
entries.affirmation: I live an enriching, nourishing, healthy life.

entries.expression: Smoky Quartz is quartz that through natural and/or artificial radiation has turned dark in colour. Traditionally used to cope with stress, fear and panic, it is a potent crystal for protection.
entries.message: Modern safeguards encourage boundary-setting and productivity.
entries.sunFocus: You are a vehicle for expression, standing up for personal rights and social justices.
entries.affirmation: I ardently declare my personal truth.

entries.expression: During the Stone Age, Flint was used for tools; it is a type of quartz. Traditionally, Flint stone resonates with fire and air, energy and thought, and spurs on action.
entries.message: Strength and accuracy, combined with stability.
entries.sunFocus: A successful balance between thought and action promotes camaraderie and sportsmanship.
entries.affirmation: I am poised and confident, ready to skilfully aim my ideas towards action.

entries.sabianSymbol: An airplane appears to free-fall towards earth
entries.expression: Eudialyte is a red, orange, or pink cyclosilicate mineral. Spiritually, Eudialyte reflects the pace of modern life and helps calm workplace anxiety.
entries.message: Recycling energy, refining expectations through new experiences.
entries.sunFocus: Your constant strength of character supports others to soar through life’s ups and downs.
entries.affirmation: I am prepared to respond quickly to any emergency.

entries.sabianSymbol: Newly opened lands offer the pioneer new opportunities.
entries.expression: Tsavorite is a green garnet, rich in vanadium and chromium. Traditionally, Tsavorite is a source of illumination for physical and spiritual growth.
entries.message: A fresh start, new beginnings, nourishing all stages of spiritual evolution.
entries.sunFocus: You recognise others’ pain and empathise with them, providing avenues for growth and understanding.
entries.affirmation: I see great opportunities born from simplicity.

entries.sabianSymbol: A slave girl demands her rights
entries.expression: Cubic Zirconia is synthesized and optically flawless, primarily used as a diamond simulant. Contemporary in energy, Cubic Zirconia supports a modern lifestyle.
entries.message: Embracing scattered energies and transforming them into intense rays.
entries.sunFocus: Passionate communication reforms old patterns, and ensures new patterns emerge and are sustained.
entries.affirmation: I command attention and establish new standards.

entries.sabianSymbol: A great musician at his piano
